decisions.reason: The new hero copy describes product features such as Carfax, window sticker, and quote links, but does not change the required hero image format, depicted controls, gallery, or phone-frame presentation.
Replacing the hero text does not change the landing page's content types, image quantity, screenshot policy, or overall composition requirement.
The source changes only the first-section hero copy and does not alter the founder image or its bottom-of-page placement.
The copy replacement does not change the clean minimal SaaS aesthetic, use of brand assets, or Loom style reference.
The hero copy does not mention or change the dealer-login button's top-right-only placement.
The phrase about texting or emailing a generated sales page is product-description copy and does not change contact-form submission recipients or lead delivery.
The hero copy replacement has no effect on transferring the Webflow website to the client's workspace.
The hero copy replacement does not change the requirement to select the cheapest available Webflow site plan.
